description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and enhance their quality of life through skilled therapeutic interventions.

As a PTA, you will work closely with licensed Physical Therapists to implement individualized treatment plans, monitor patient progress, and provide compassionate care. We offer a competitive hourly rate and a supportive environment where your expertise will be valued.
requirements: Valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited PTA program
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate ranges from $28.00 to $37.00, based on experience.

description:
Join a dedicated team as a Full-time Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) in Gainesville, FL. We are seeking a passionate and skilled professional to provide comprehensive speech, language, and swallowing therapy services to our residents at a premier health and rehabilitation center.

In this vital role, you will assess, diagnose, and treat communication and swallowing disorders, developing individualized treatment plans to help patients achieve their highest potential. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to ensure integrated and holistic care, contributing significantly to our patients' quality of life. This full-time position offers competitive hourly compensation.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP)
Experience working in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $40.00 - $52.00 per hour, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Family Medicine Physician (MD) to join a premier medical group with locations across Harlem, The Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens, and Long Island. This is an exceptional opportunity for a physician who thrives in a dynamic environment and is motivated by a compensation structure heavily weighted towards bonuses.

In this role, you will focus on patients with workers' compensation or NF/Lien cases, as our practice does not work with major medical insurances, Medicare, or Medicaid. The position requires availability to work weekends to best serve our patient population. If you are WCB certified and possess relevant experience, we encourage you to apply.

Join a team committed to providing specialized care in a supportive setting. This role offers a unique chance to make a significant impact while benefiting from a robust bonus structure.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) degree and valid New York state medical license
Demonstrated experience with workers' compensation or NF/Lien cases
Ability to work weekends as required
Comfortable working with patients outside of major medical insurance, Medicare, or Medicaid systems
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is heavily weighted towards bonuses, with a base salary of approximately $180,000 per year.
